item.title: Monaco to celebrate Year of the Fire Horse with Chinese New Year gala
item.description: The Association Monaco-Chine and Monaco Dragon Prestige will host an evening of haute couture, gastronomy and traditional performances at the Méridien Beach Plaza on Wednesday, 11th February.

item.title: European Commission opens investigation into X over AI tool’s child safety risks
item.description: The EU is examining whether X properly assessed dangers before deploying Grok, after reports the AI tool generated sexually explicit images of minors visible to all users.

item.title: JCI Monaco unveils new programmes to support young entrepreneurs
item.description: The Junior Economic Chamber of Monaco (JCI) has outlined its plans for 2026, including new initiatives for students and changes to existing programmes.

item.title: Monaco launches major justice reform with focus on transparency and financial crime
item.description: Monaco is rolling out sweeping justice reforms this year aimed at restoring public trust and tackling financial crime.

item.title: Child protection chief: Roblox and AI tools hiding predators in plain sight
item.description: Sarah El Haïry told a Paris conference that 750,000 paedophile criminals operate daily on the internet, with children at risk on platforms perceived as harmless such as Roblox.

item.title: Disney in Concert returns to Monaco with symphonic celebration
item.description: The Grimaldi Forum will host Disney en Concert – Suivez vos Rêves (Follow Your Dreams) on 24th October, bringing together a symphony orchestra, singers and dancers for a journey through classic Disney soundtracks.

item.title: Olivier Wenden appointed Director of Prince Albert II’s Cabinet
item.description: Prince Albert II has appointed Olivier Wenden as the new Director of the Prince's Cabinet, one of the most senior positions in Monaco's government structure.

item.title: Video report – ‘I want to feel alive’: how AI revived Dilara’s message after Monaco tragedy
item.description: A powerful AI-generated video brings back the voice of 19-year-old Dilara Akhundova, killed in a 2023 Monaco crash, to deliver a haunting message on road safety and finish the art she left behind.

item.title: Cocteau’s spirit guides surrealist exhibition at Villefranche-sur-Mer in summer 2026
item.description: L'Absurde et le Rêve will open in summer 2026, featuring monumental outdoor installations and intimate interior works exploring surrealism and humanity's disconnection from nature.

item.title: Football: Monaco record first Ligue 1 win since November
item.description: AS Monaco ran riot against Stade Rennais (4-0) as Sébastien Pocogonoli's side secured all three points in Ligue 1 for the first time since the end of November.
